description: Send feedback to the Splits team about the API, this CLI, or the MCP server. Use it when a command fails in a way its help does not explain, a capability is missing, or a response is confusing. Include the goal, the command or request you ran, what came back, and what you expected. The Splits team gets it by email and can follow up with the user who owns the API key. Never include API keys, private keys, or other secrets.

text.description: The feedback: goal, command or request, response, and what was expected (max 5000 characters)

workspace.description: Workspace alias to run this command in (see `splits auth workspaces`). Overrides SPLITS_WORKSPACE and the active workspace.

name: feedback_send
